nodes.label: Lead Like You're Not Guarding the Door
Sloane has spent a year designing a new tradition, the Living Legacy.
Vivienne's final ledger entry is a sponsored commission, sealed and then withdrawn by her, nineteen days before she died.
Sloane decides this Grand Exchange is her last as the one who decides. She keeps hosting and taking impossible requests (Hybrid H).
The leak chain: Royce's inference rests on Marcus, who overheard Bunny, who heard it from Richard.
Kai's anonymous commission ten years ago, at 24, was written by Vivienne for Celestine, then withdrawn.
Vivienne and Celestine designed the Ember together (copper no, gold yes); Vivienne gave it away and only the no was adopted.
Celestine has a vision she never built, and will never ask for it.
Vivienne's private truth behind the sealed envelope (U-1).
Emmett Hale's identity (U-3). FD-09 approved his function only.
The third of three looks on the bed: the one that moves when she spins.
Half-dressed state before the party look is fastened (robe over the third look).
One suit language for the season.
Formal-casual: tailored waistcoat, quiet-luxury jewelry; dressed for a door he knows will not open.
A plus-one dressed to be noticed.
A bold orange jacket by Wendell Ames, Ferry Street.
A slice of coconut cake on a plate
